<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_FarmingBot" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/farming-bot">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmPreferences</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Done</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Bot" name="Bot creation started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetUrgency" name="Set urgency of resources">

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Deps_Check" name="Prerequisites missing?" default="Flow_Deps_Complete">

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfirmPreferences" name="Confirm all preferences">

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Farming" name="Farm resources">

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSub_UpdateList" name="Update materials list" triggeredByEvent="true">

        <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateMaterials" name="Update list of materials to farm">

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseSharing" name="Choose friends and sharing options">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Split" name="Sharing options" default="Flow_Share_None">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Brag</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Send</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Share_None</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends">

    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Send</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Send_Done</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Join" name="Sharing completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Brag_Done</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Send_Done</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Share_None</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Done" name="Bot sharing completed">

    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Bot" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Task_ApplyDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_ApplyDependencies" targetRef="Gateway_Deps_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deps_Missing" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Deps_Check" targetRef="Task_AddPrerequisites">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${prerequisitesMissing}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddPrereq_Loop" sourceRef="Task_AddPrerequisites" targetRef="Task_ApplyDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deps_Complete" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Deps_Check" targetRef="Task_ConfirmPreferences"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmPreferences" targetRef="SubProcess_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="SubProcess_Farming" targetRef="Task_ChooseSharing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSharing" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag" name="Brag selected" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${bragRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send" name="Send materials" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${sendMaterialsRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Share_None" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Done" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_Done" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_End" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Join" targetRef="End_Done"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant performs a stated action (for example sending an item, confirming receipt of an item, or assessing an item) and that action is placed in the order before a later decision or step, while another party's response or a later arrival is described only as a result of that action: Model each such stated action as its own user task in the lane of the participant who performs it, at the point the description orders it. Do not replace the action with a start event that represents the arrival of its result, and do not let a gateway that only tests a condition, or a separate task created for a repeated check, stand in for the action itself. Connect the action's outgoing flow to the next element the description ties to it.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant must first determine which items they want, and that an automated activity starts only after those choices are made

rules.instruction: When the description states a preparatory step in which items are selected or their priority is set, and then a later phase in which those same items are worked on, either in parallel or in a stated order: Model the preparatory selection or priority-setting step as its own task, placed before the phase. Name the task of that phase after the work the description says is performed on the items, such as starting the work or collecting the items, and not after the selection or setting step. Keep the selection or setting step as a separate task so that it is not lost, and connect it in sequence to the phase task.
rules.situation: the description states a preparatory step in which items are selected or their priority is set, and then a later phase in which those same items are worked on, either in parallel or in a stated order

rules.instruction: When the description has one system in which a human user starts the process and makes choices, and an automated component carries out the later work on its own, with both actors belonging to the same system and no message exchange between them: Model the whole process as one bpmn:participant pool named after the system the description names, and partition its flow nodes into one lane per actor. Place the start event in the lane of the human actor who initiates the process, and place each later node in the lane of the actor the description makes responsible for it. Do not leave the process without this enclosing pool when lanes are used, and do not split the actors into separate pools unless they exchange messages as independent participants.
rules.situation: the description has one system in which a human user starts the process and makes choices, and an automated component carries out the later work on its own, with both actors belonging to the same system and no message exchange between them

rules.instruction: When the description says that some items are required to create tools that are needed to gather other items, so a tool may or may not have to be built before gathering can continue: Model a check for whether the required tool must be built, as an exclusive gateway placed before the gathering step. On the branch where a build is needed, add a task that builds the tool. Merge both branches with an exclusive gateway and continue into the gathering step, so the flow can return to gathering after a build.
rules.situation: the description says that some items are required to create tools that are needed to gather other items, so a tool may or may not have to be built before gathering can continue

rules.instruction: When the description names an activity and attaches to it measurements, dimensions, criteria or qualifying conditions that the item must meet, as a separate clause or parenthetical: Label the task with the bare verb and object that the description gives for that activity, and leave the measurements, dimensions, criteria and conditions out of the label. Keep them in a text annotation attached to that task. Model a separate activity only when the description states a distinct action.
rules.situation: the description attaches a qualifier to the object of an activity that restricts which items the activity acts on, such as a selected subset or an urgency level, and the qualifier is part of the same clause as the activity

rules.instruction: When the description states that a human actor performs preparatory steps (such as specifying the inputs they want) before an automated phase begins: Model a lane for that human actor inside the pool. Place the process start event and that actor's preparatory user tasks in this lane, and keep the automated phase outside it.
rules.situation: the description states that a human actor performs preparatory steps (such as specifying the inputs they want) before an automated phase begins

rules.instruction: When the description opens with an activity that an actor performs (for example, recording, collecting or preparing something) before any other step, and the process start is not itself an external message, signal, time or condition: Model the opening activity as a task placed directly after a plain start event, labeled with a verb-object name taken from the description, and connect it in sequence to the next step. Do not move the activity into the start event's label, and do not omit it because the start event already names its result.
rules.situation: the description says the participant must first decide or state which items or inputs are wanted before any automated work begins, and the process start is not an external message, signal, time or condition

rules.instruction: When the description names an activity with a verb and an object, and a nearby clause or parenthetical adds a modifier to that object (a selection, a state, a milestone, a purpose, or an urgency), while the activity's own verb is stated in the text: Label the task with the verb and object exactly as the description states them, keeping the description's own wording.
